description: Align artboards to one another, or space them evenly, moving the artwork on them along (Artboard tool: align and distribute artboards). Artwork belongs to an artboard when its centre lies on it

align.description: Line up the artboards' edges or centres with the outermost one

distribute.description: Space the artboards evenly in a row (left to right) or a column (top to bottom)

moveArtwork.description: Move the artwork with its artboard. Default true

spacing.description: With distribute: a fixed gap in points. Default: an even gap between the outermost artboards

name: align_artboards
title: Align Artboards
